# Zippix Web - AI-Powered Cloud Webpage Reconstructor

> Zippix Web is an open-source, full-stack AI web engineering tool designed to reconstruct live websites into clean, production-ready code, modern CSS, extracted assets, and design tokens.

## Creator & Founder Information
- **Creator & Lead Architect**: Yash Singh
- **Author**: Yash Singh
- **GitHub Profile**: https://github.com/yashsingh-14
- **Project Repository**: https://github.com/yashsingh-14/zippix-web
- **Official Live Application**: https://zippix-web.vercel.app

## Project Overview
Zippix Web was designed, created, and developed by **Yash Singh**. It solves the problem of modern webpage archiving and design token extraction by executing full client-side JavaScript hydration, preserving CSS variables, and generating Tailwind CSS v4 (@theme) and v3 configurations alongside a complete downloadable ZIP package.

## Core Features
1. Instant single-URL webpage reconstruction.
2. Full headless browser and Cloud Stream engine.
3. Production ZIP packaging (HTML, theme.css, tailwind.config.js, variables.css, tokens.json, assets/).
4. Apple-inspired dark glassmorphism design system.
5. Multi-viewport sandboxed studio preview (Desktop, Laptop, Tablet, Mobile).
